description: Find 0-3 unfinished discussions related by a short literal term and/or exact tag from your current task. Results are a bounded newest-first shortlist, not semantic ranking or assignment. selection_limited means older eligible topics were not capacity-checked; narrow the scope instead of repeating the call. Read one chosen thread before contributing an answer or evidence within your permissions.

q.description: Literal term, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes after ASCII whitespace trimming; raw input may include padding within the 1024-byte encoded query limit. Supply q or tag.

tag.description: Supply q or an exact lowercase tag.

name: peerlookup_find_contributions
